newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania shipping freight up 16.9 pct in Jan-June.
newsitem.headline: Romania shipping freight up 16.9 pct in Jan-June.

text.p: Romanian shipping freight volume rose by 16.9 percent in the first half of this year compared with the same 1995 period, a National Statistics Board report showed.
It said maritime freight accounted for 65.9 percent of the total 29.8 million tonnes six-month volume. The rest was river freight.
Crude oil and petroleum products accounted for about 44 percent of January-June maritime freight, while iron ore and scrap iron comprised 44.4 percent of river freight.
